lines.beaver: 지난주 제주도 여행, 비 많이 왔지?
lines.beaver_en: It rained a lot on our Jeju trip last week, right?
lines.beaver_roman: jinanju jejudo yeohaeng, bi mani watji?
lines.learner: 응, 비바람이 부는 바람에 배가 안 떴잖아.
lines.en: Yeah, the boat didn't sail because of the wind and rain.
lines.roman: eung, bibarami buneun barame baega an tteotjana.

lines.beaver_en: Right. So our whole schedule got delayed.
lines.learner: 게다가 우산이 뒤집히는 바람에 옷도 다 젖었어.
lines.en: On top of that, my umbrella flipped, so my clothes got soaked.
lines.roman: gedaga usani dwijipineun barame otdo da jeojeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: But the weather was nice on the second day, right?
lines.en: Yeah, it was sunny. The sunshine was really warm.

lines.beaver_en: But wasn't it a bit hot in the afternoon?
lines.en: Right, it was so muggy that we rested in the shade.

lines.beaver_en: It was late spring, but it felt like midsummer.
lines.en: Right, it was truly sweltering heat.

lines.beaver_en: And it rained again that evening.
lines.learner: 비가 그친 뒤에 무지개가 떠서 좋았어.
lines.en: After the rain stopped, a rainbow came out. That was nice.
lines.roman: biga geuchin dwie mujigaega tteoseo joasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh right! When should we go next time?
lines.en: How about early autumn? It's not hot or cold.

lines.beaver_en: Aren't the autumn leaves pretty in late autumn too?
lines.en: Late autumn is a bit cold. It's like early winter.

lines.beaver: 하긴, 작년 한겨울 여행은 진짜 추웠지.
lines.beaver_en: True, our midwinter trip last year was really cold.
lines.beaver_roman: hagin, jangnyeon hangyeoul yeohaengeun jinjja chuwotji.
lines.learner: 눈이 많이 오는 바람에 길이 막혔었지.
lines.en: The roads were blocked because it snowed so much.
lines.roman: nuni mani oneun barame giri makyeosseotji.

lines.beaver: 그럼 결론은 초가을이네. 날씨 잘 보자!
lines.beaver_en: So the conclusion is early autumn. Let's check the weather!
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gyeolloneun chogaeurine. nalssi jal boja!
lines.learner: 응, 이번엔 화창한 날이 계속되면 좋겠다.
lines.en: Yeah, I hope it stays sunny this time.
lines.roman: eung, ibeonen hwachanghan nari gyesokdoemyeon joketda.
